title: Case 027: Access Restored
initial_request: I can’t sign in to my H&V profile after several unsuccessful attempts. Please help me regain access safely so I can review my household spending.
overview: Mara Ellison escalated repeated sign-in failures for her H&V profile. After H&V identification checks on a verified call, the agent directed her to the bank’s secure recovery process. The recovery system completed its checks and recorded that access was restored.

next_action.summary: The agent directs Mara to complete recovery through the official secure portal; the agent does not handle her password or verification details.

outcome: H&V’s system recorded that profile access was restored. No other banking operations were changed or authorised.

events.body: Sign-in declined. Use H&V’s secure recovery process to restore access.
I’ve completed H&V’s identification checks for this call. I still can’t sign in to my profile, and I need help restoring access; I’m not sharing any password or verification code.
I’m directing you to the recovery option in H&V’s secure portal. Complete the checks there; I won’t ask you to tell me your password or a verification code.
Recovery checks completed securely. Return to sign-in.
Access restored and recorded by the system. You can now sign in.
